description: This file is the main front-end HTML page for a database visualization tool. It provides a user interface to browse databases, display tables, and view table data, including client-side JavaScript for fetching and rendering database information dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from server and populates sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting state and fetching latest list.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show/hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific table and renders it.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for the table data display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling special cases like objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expanded view of cell content for long strings or objects.
